---
title: "R Notebook Angle elbow Mp/Vicon"

---


```{r}
# =========================
# Stats angle coude MP vs Vicon
# =========================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)

# -------------------------
# 1) Paths
# -------------------------



angle_files <- tibble(

  projection = c("XY", "XZ", "YZ"),

  path = c(

    "ANGLE_elbow_MP_vs_VICON_planeXY_noInterp.xlsx",

    "ANGLE_elbow_MP_vs_VICON_planeXZ_noInterp.xlsx",

    "ANGLE_elbow_MP_vs_VICON_planeYZ_noInterp.xlsx"

  )

)

# Vérifier les chemins
print(angle_files)
print(file.exists(angle_files$path))

# -------------------------
# 2) Load and bind files
# -------------------------

angle_data <- angle_files %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(data = list(read_excel(path))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(projection, data) %>%
  unnest(data)

# Garder uniquement les lignes valides
angle_data <- angle_data %>%
  filter(is.na(error) | error == "")

# -------------------------
# 3) Résumé par projection
# -------------------------

angle_summary <- angle_data %>%
  group_by(projection) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    
    # MediaPipe vs Vicon projeté 2D
    mean_r_VI2_R = mean(corr_MP_vs_VI2_R, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r_VI2_R = sd(corr_MP_vs_VI2_R, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r_VI2_L = mean(corr_MP_vs_VI2_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r_VI2_L = sd(corr_MP_vs_VI2_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_r_VI2_bilateral = mean(c(corr_MP_vs_VI2_R, corr_MP_vs_VI2_L), na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r_VI2_bilateral = sd(c(corr_MP_vs_VI2_R, corr_MP_vs_VI2_L), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_RMSE_VI2_R = mean(rmse_MP_vs_VI2_R, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RMSE_VI2_R = sd(rmse_MP_vs_VI2_R, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_RMSE_VI2_L = mean(rmse_MP_vs_VI2_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RMSE_VI2_L = sd(rmse_MP_vs_VI2_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_RMSE_VI2_bilateral = mean(c(rmse_MP_vs_VI2_R, rmse_MP_vs_VI2_L), na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RMSE_VI2_bilateral = sd(c(rmse_MP_vs_VI2_R, rmse_MP_vs_VI2_L), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # MediaPipe vs Vicon 3D
    mean_r_VI3_R = mean(corr_MP_vs_VI3_R, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r_VI3_R = sd(corr_MP_vs_VI3_R, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r_VI3_L = mean(corr_MP_vs_VI3_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r_VI3_L = sd(corr_MP_vs_VI3_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_r_VI3_bilateral = mean(c(corr_MP_vs_VI3_R, corr_MP_vs_VI3_L), na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r_VI3_bilateral = sd(c(corr_MP_vs_VI3_R, corr_MP_vs_VI3_L), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_RMSE_VI3_R = mean(rmse_MP_vs_VI3_R, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RMSE_VI3_R = sd(rmse_MP_vs_VI3_R, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_RMSE_VI3_L = mean(rmse_MP_vs_VI3_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RMSE_VI3_L = sd(rmse_MP_vs_VI3_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_RMSE_VI3_bilateral = mean(c(rmse_MP_vs_VI3_R, rmse_MP_vs_VI3_L), na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RMSE_VI3_bilateral = sd(c(rmse_MP_vs_VI3_R, rmse_MP_vs_VI3_L), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_RMSE_VI2_bilateral)

print(angle_summary)

# -------------------------
# 4) Format long pour figures
# -------------------------

angle_long <- angle_data %>%
  select(
    projection, dyad, condition, pid,
    corr_MP_vs_VI2_R, corr_MP_vs_VI2_L,
    rmse_MP_vs_VI2_R, rmse_MP_vs_VI2_L,
    corr_MP_vs_VI3_R, corr_MP_vs_VI3_L,
    rmse_MP_vs_VI3_R, rmse_MP_vs_VI3_L
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("corr_MP_vs") | starts_with("rmse_MP_vs"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reference = case_when(
      grepl("VI2", metric) ~ "Vicon projected 2D",
      grepl("VI3", metric) ~ "Vicon 3D",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    side = case_when(
      grepl("_R$", metric) ~ "Right",
      grepl("_L$", metric) ~ "Left",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    outcome = case_when(
      grepl("^corr", metric) ~ "Correlation r",
      grepl("^rmse", metric) ~ "RMSE",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# -------------------------
# 5) Figures r
# -------------------------

p_r <- angle_long %>%
  filter(outcome == "Correlation r") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = projection, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(reference ~ side) +
  labs(
    title = "Elbow angle tracking: MediaPipe vs Vicon",
    x = "Vicon projection plane",
    y = "Participant-level Pearson correlation"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p_r)
ggsave("elbow_angle_correlations.png", p_r, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# -------------------------
# 6) Figures RMSE
# -------------------------

p_rmse <- angle_long %>%
  filter(outcome == "RMSE") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = projection, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(reference ~ side) +
  labs(
    title = "Elbow angle tracking error: MediaPipe vs Vicon",
    x = "Vicon projection plane",
    y = "RMSE (degrees)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p_rmse)
ggsave("elbow_angle_rmse.png", p_rmse, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# -------------------------
# 7) Identifier le meilleur plan
# -------------------------

best_plane_rmse <- angle_summary %>%
  select(
    projection,
    mean_r_VI2_bilateral,
    sd_r_VI2_bilateral,
    mean_RMSE_VI2_bilateral,
    sd_RMSE_VI2_bilateral
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_RMSE_VI2_bilateral)

print(best_plane_rmse)

# -------------------------
# 8) Export
# -------------------------

write_xlsx(
  list(
    angle_summary = angle_summary,
    angle_long = angle_long,
    best_plane_rmse = best_plane_rmse
  ),
  "elbow_angle_validity_results.xlsx"
)
```
